stories.title: Russian envoy says nuclear war with NATO inching closer
stories.description: Russia's OSCE envoy Dmitry Polyansky accused NATO members of joining drone attacks on Russian ships in the Baltic Sea.

stories.title: Trump says Nvidia's Huang is not a security threat
stories.description: Trump cited "a lot of information" even though the Justice Department never opened a formal probe, and called Huang's reinstatement "a great thing."

stories.title: Thanksgiving storms knock out power to over 700,000
stories.description: A strengthening nor'easter and Midwest snow hit Virginia, Maryland and Missouri hardest, canceling flights and forcing postponement of Macy's 100th parade.

stories.title: IISS warns Russian sabotage in Europe risks mass casualties
stories.description: A London think tank says incidents involving explosives and arson roughly doubled over the past year, with Germany and Poland hit hardest.

stories.title: Iran denies Kuwait drone strike that killed two Italians
stories.description: Military spokesperson Abolfazl Shekarchi called the accusations a false-flag pretext, after Kuwait and Italy said Iranian drones targeted an air-defense site.

stories.title: Trump calls pre-election GDP data fake, demands investigation
stories.description: Trump alleged without evidence that a routine revision lifting third-quarter growth to 4.3% from 3.4% exposed a deliberate pre-election undercount.

stories.title: Iran rations power, cuts bread subsidies under US blockade
stories.description: President Masoud Pezeshkian told state television "we have no money" as a U.S. naval blockade and months of war drain Iran's finances.

stories.title: UK net migration falls to 77,000, lowest since 1997
stories.description: ONS provisional figures show net migration more than halved in a year, driven by fewer non-EU arrivals for work and study.

stories.title: France defends Ukraine's Libya strikes as Italy objects
stories.description: Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot cited Kyiv's right to self-defense, while Italy's Antonio Tajani said the strikes near Benghazi violated Libya's sovereignty.

stories.title: NATO allies expect US to delay Europe troop cut decision
stories.description: Allies now expect cuts of about 5,000 troops, mostly in Germany, as the Trump administration focuses on Ukraine peace talks, Bloomberg reports.

stories.title: Kim urges wider tactical nuclear deployment on site tour
stories.description: Touring nuclear material factories and a weapons institute, Kim called North Korea's nuclear status "absolutely inviolable," according to state media KCNA.

stories.title: Kushner says Putin showed restraint, vowed not to use nuclear weapons
stories.description: In a podcast interview, the White House envoy called Putin a "grandmaster of politics" and said territorial talks on Ukraine are deadlocked.

stories.title: Storm pushes 100th Macy's parade to Saturday, a first
stories.description: Forecast gusts near 60 mph on Thanksgiving Day exceed balloon safety limits. NBC will air the 2025 parade Thursday instead.

stories.title: Judge upholds Mamdani's rent freeze, tosses landlord suit
stories.description: Justice Brendan Lantry found the Rent Guidelines Board acted rationally, though he called Mamdani's campaign freeze pledge "reckless and irresponsible."

stories.title: Democrats demand AI curbs over unreleased model fears
stories.description: Sens. Kelly, Schatz and Van Hollen, joined by Sanders, urged swift guardrails after insiders doubted labs can safely control unreleased systems.

stories.title: Finland, Norway used oligarch to reach Putin, WSJ says
stories.description: Stubb and Støre sought to ease Kremlin fears of a NATO blockade in the Baltic Sea before their Oct. 27 call with Putin.

stories.title: EU, China reject US overcapacity claims behind new tariffs
stories.description: Trade Representative Greer proposed Section 301 duties on 14 economies, including 15% on EU goods and up to 20% on Chinese imports.

stories.title: FCC clears SpaceX for 1 million orbital data centers
stories.description: The FCC approved SpaceX's Starmind constellation, which the agency says will help meet fast-growing demand for AI computing power.

stories.title: Poland to create no-fly zone along Ukraine border
stories.description: Deputy Defense Minister Cezary Tomczyk said the ordinance should take effect around year's end, after Russian missile and drone incursions.

stories.title: Army detonates lead azide stockpile in Iowa despite outcry
stories.description: The controlled blast near Middletown destroyed the nation's entire stock of the degraded explosive after a court cleared the EPA's emergency permit.

stories.title: Macron vows to halt EU budget talks without December deal
stories.description: The warning came a day before a Brussels summit, as France rejects proposed cuts to farm aid in the EU's 2028–2034 budget.

stories.title: Alice Huang-linked firms used $270M AI servers for loans
stories.description: Chinese central-bank filings reviewed by Reuters show firms tied to her family leased or pledged the hardware, days after Washington blacklisted Megaspeed.

stories.title: Fed's preferred inflation gauge climbs to 3.8% in October
stories.description: Core PCE rose to 3.3%, above forecasts, strengthening expectations of a rate hike at the Federal Reserve's Dec. 8–9 meeting.

stories.title: US shelves Russia business lure in Ukraine talks, FT says
stories.description: Envoys Kushner and Witkoff told Europeans corporate partnerships are no longer central after Moscow showed little interest; a US official disputed it.

stories.title: Trump approves disaster declaration for Florida flooding
stories.description: Federal aid will help residents in six counties as National Guard troops clear flooded Hollywood homes and Lake Monroe nears its crest.

stories.title: US proposes tariffs up to 20% on China, EU, 12 others
stories.description: The USTR wrapped up its excess-capacity probe for 14 economies. The duties could take effect as early as January, after public hearings.

stories.title: US jury convicts Huawei of bank fraud, trade secret theft
stories.description: A Brooklyn federal jury found the Chinese tech giant guilty on 10 of 12 counts but acquitted it of racketeering conspiracy.

stories.title: CIA, ODNI hit by breach of open-source intel network
stories.description: The intrusion exposed some unclassified information on an open-source analysis platform. Officials say classified systems were not affected, and the attacker remains unknown.

stories.title: Trump aides debate targeting Iran's leaders, NBC reports
stories.description: Supporters say striking Iran's leadership could end the nearly nine-month war. Critics warn it could embolden remaining hardliners and endanger U.S. officials.

stories.title: DOJ targets 800-plus defendants in largest scam crackdown
stories.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche says prosecutors recovered over $8 billion in intended victim losses, with the FBI citing nearly $17 billion restrained.

stories.title: US consumer confidence jumps to 103.3 after midterms
stories.description: The Conference Board's index beat forecasts and returned to levels last seen in January 2025 as job optimism grew and gas prices fell.

stories.title: Zelenskyy confirms drone strike on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland
stories.description: He called cargo vessel Sparta II a legitimate target, claiming it carried weapons, ending Kyiv's silence on the Gulf of Finland attack.

stories.title: Riyadh's tallest tower struck again in less than a week
stories.description: The Saudi-led coalition called Tuesday's strike on the Public Investment Fund tower a "cowardly terrorist attack." No group has claimed responsibility.

stories.title: Pentagon in talks with GM, Ford on drones, report says
stories.description: Automakers would supply motors, sensors and parts as the military plans to buy millions of drones, according to The Wall Street Journal.

stories.title: Pentagon chief stalls Patriot missiles for Ukraine, FT says
stories.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth hasn't approved about 60 allied-funded interceptors as Russia intensifies strikes on Ukrainian cities and energy infrastructure before winter.

stories.title: Russian warplanes in South Korean airspace spark shelter alert
stories.description: South Korea's military says the planes entered KADIZ but never violated its airspace, correcting earlier alerts, one wrongly citing North Korean aircraft.

stories.title: US probes Iran over cyberattacks on up to 50 ships
stories.description: Some crews received bomb threats, The Wall Street Journal reports, and investigators also see Russia as a possible culprit.

stories.title: Senate Democrat probes Vance over Vitol Venezuela oil deal
stories.description: Sen. Maggie Hassan cites flight records placing Vance and a Vitol donor in Montana before Maduro's capture. Vance's office denies the meeting.

stories.title: US weighs demining training mission for Syrian army
stories.description: It would be the first US training mission with Syria's military since former rebels took power in 2024, sources told Reuters.

stories.title: Meduza, Mediazona estimate 700,000 Russian war dead
stories.description: The exiled outlets based the figure on hacked Rosstat mortality records showing at least 490,000 registered military deaths through late September.

stories.title: Trump slams Newsom's death row commutations at DOJ
stories.description: Trump said he will sign a directive ordering the Justice Department to seek death sentences for child murderers and to speed up federal executions.

stories.title: Iran says four tankers hit mines in Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: Tehran says two of the vessels sailed with US Central Command support. No ships were named, and no one has independently confirmed the claims.

stories.title: Backlash grows after COP31 collapses over fossil fuels
stories.description: The EU and Pacific nations rejected a final draft omitting fossil fuels, ending the record-long Antalya summit Sunday without an overarching agreement.

stories.title: 2nd Circuit revives Trump bid to move hush money case
stories.description: A three-judge panel said a lower-court judge erred in blocking removal and sent the case back to district court for a prompt ruling.

stories.title: Rep. Jimmy Gomez to resign after House Ethics findings
stories.description: The committee found "substantial evidence" the Los Angeles Democrat made unwelcome sexual advances toward a House staffer; he disputes the report's conclusions.

stories.title: NATO intelligence warns Russia readying nuclear satellite
stories.description: A German media investigation says the Sputnik-S satellite, stored near Moscow, could launch by December. Russia's embassy calls the claims propaganda.

stories.title: OpenAI chief scientist urges perplexity-based AI limits
stories.description: Jakub Pachocki's essay seeks industry-wide development caps and discloses OpenAI's internal pretraining data for the first time; no other lab has joined.

stories.title: DNI Clayton says Putin 'not America's friend in Ukraine'
stories.description: Clayton also defended Trump calling Putin his "friend" at last week's Shenzhen summit with Xi, saying he trusts the president "completely."

stories.title: Gov. Ferguson says ICE 'beyond reform' after Sea-Tac arrests
stories.description: Masked agents detained two people on a jet bridge as passengers boarded an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles on Saturday.

stories.title: Iran calls US blockade act of war, vows to break it
stories.description: Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi also said Qatari mediators visited Tehran for talks, as Revolutionary Guards claimed strikes on US sites in Bahrain.

stories.title: Trump says US working on broader Russia-Ukraine truce
stories.description: Trump called the truce that Melania Trump brokered to evacuate civilians from Russian-occupied Oleshky a pilot project. He gave no timeline for a wider deal.

stories.title: Crimean Bridge cleanup to take months, Khmara says
stories.description: Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara said Russian divers are still assessing the collapsed span, which now blocks ships passing through the Kerch Strait.

stories.title: Turnout falls at France's sixth weekend of protests
stories.description: The Interior Ministry counted 82,500 marchers nationwide, down from a week earlier, as clashes broke out in Marseille, Lyon and Lille.

stories.title: WSJ: Kim snubbed Trump outreach as summit bid collapsed
stories.description: Kim ignored contact attempts, including an unopened letter, and Pyongyang's conditions sank a planned meeting during Trump's Asia trip, the Journal reported.

stories.title: Bolsonaro in ICU with bowel obstruction, surgery weighed
stories.description: DF Star hospital says the former president, serving a 27-year coup sentence, is stable and conscious, with no discharge date set.

stories.title: White House to scale back special employee status
stories.description: Chief of staff Stephen Miller wants to wind down the designation letting staffers keep outside salaries, The Wall Street Journal reported.

stories.title: Vance won't say he would have ordered Iran strikes
stories.description: Standing beside Trump on Friday, Vance said the decision belonged to the president, sidestepping Trump's push to call the attacks necessary.

stories.title: Israeli strikes across southern Lebanon strain US-brokered deal
stories.description: Israeli drones, jets and artillery hit towns in southern Lebanon on Friday and Saturday, following a Thursday strike deep in the Bekaa Valley.

stories.title: Jeffries vows first-week House push to end Iran war
stories.description: The speaker nominee also called Gaza's devastation "unacceptable" and urged a surge in humanitarian aid and a two-state solution.

stories.title: FBI questions ex-Fulton elections chief in 2020 probe
stories.description: Richard Barron, who oversaw Fulton County's 2020 count, said prosecutors including Dan Bishop focused on debunked claims and "trivial topics."

stories.title: Denmark urges EU to halt tourist visas for Russians
stories.description: Copenhagen will present its proposals to EU ambassadors Monday after Danish intelligence blamed Russia for a foiled plot to kill rapper Kyivstoner.

stories.title: Trump says any deal to end Iran war must be 'permanent'
stories.description: Trump said he wants an agreement binding future presidents. He cited Iran's record of broken deals as the war nears nine months.

stories.title: Young Europeans strike over living costs, rearmament
stories.description: Students in at least 25 countries walked out Friday, saying money spent on military buildups should go to schools and housing instead.

stories.title: Iran's Araghchi says China, Russia oppose doctrine shift
stories.description: Araghchi said Tehran's rejection of nuclear weapons remains unchanged, as hardliners push for a deterrent after wars with Israel and the US.

stories.title: Iran unveils launcher that fires two missiles at once
stories.description: State TV aired footage from an underground "missile city" to counter U.S. claims it destroyed Iran's missile program, amid new tanker attacks.

stories.title: Trump says FBI crime database hack could reveal 'hoaxes'
stories.description: The president told Fox News the National Crime Information Center breach might expose details on the Russia probe and voter fraud.

stories.title: Canada says no shift after Hegseth memo restricts ties
stories.description: Defense Minister David McGuinty said he hadn't seen the classified Pentagon memo, which reportedly limits U.S.-Canada military engagement outside NORAD and NATO.

stories.title: US military denies Iran claim it damaged F-16 over Gulf
stories.description: Central Command called Iran's account false and said all US fighter jets in the Middle East are safe and accounted for.

stories.title: Iran's president says economic war harder than missiles
stories.description: Masoud Pezeshkian warned damaged gas infrastructure will make winter hard, saying government offices, not factories, would lose power first during shortages.

stories.title: Trump says he'd work with Democrats on credit card cap
stories.description: Trump told Fox News card companies "are getting too much," after Sen. Elizabeth Warren offered to help pass a 10% cap.

stories.title: Zelensky rejects Musk claim he lied about Starshield
stories.description: Ukraine's president told CNN his reports of military satellite disruptions were "100% truth," days after Musk accused him of lying.

stories.title: Israeli strikes kill four in Gaza as floods swamp camps
stories.description: Aid agencies say over 100,000 tents remain stuck outside Gaza, while COGAT says more than 93,000 have entered.

stories.title: Trump orders contractors to flag congressional info requests
stories.description: Signed Friday, the order threatens noncompliant companies with lost contracts as Democrats prepare to take over Congress and launch investigations.

stories.title: DHS urges staff to keep holiday talk about jobs vague
stories.description: An email from the department's counterintelligence division gave employees scripted answers, like saying they work for the federal government near Washington.

stories.title: Mexico captures FBI most-wanted fugitive 'El Chapo Isidro'
stories.description: Special forces seized Fausto Isidro Meza Flores in Guasave, Sinaloa, on Friday, setting off gunfire, arson and road blockades across northern Sinaloa.

stories.title: Speaker Johnson tells absent Republicans to show up
stories.description: Absences by defeated GOP members forced leaders to scrap a vote this week, with Republicans' House majority ending Jan. 3.

stories.title: Iraqi troops enter Iran-backed militia's main stronghold
stories.description: A brokered deal gives Kataib Hezbollah a month to leave Jurf al-Sakhar, which government forces had not entered in over a decade.

stories.title: Iran claims it shot down 58th US Reaper drone over Hormuz
stories.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards credited a newly deployed air defense system. The claim couldn't be independently verified, and no US response was reported.

stories.title: Houthi attacks fuel doubts on Trump's Saudi nuclear deal
stories.description: Senate aides say a disapproval vote could come as early as the week of Nov. 30, amid new security fears.

stories.title: UN talks on killer robots end without binding commitment
stories.description: Countries agreed to "elaborate" rules on autonomous weapons by 2028 after the U.S., Russia and Israel resisted a push for binding limits.

stories.title: Jury convicts Rinderknecht in Palisades Fire retrial
stories.description: The verdict came almost five months after his first trial ended in a mistrial, with jurors deadlocked 10-2 toward acquittal.

stories.title: Tusk rejects Trump's 'mistake' claim after missile crash
stories.description: Russian missiles and a drone fell in southeastern Poland during a large attack on Ukraine, hours after Trump's comments.

stories.title: Rockstar says GTA VI hit record $3.79B in day-one sales
stories.description: The launch-day haul tops Avengers: Endgame's lifetime box office, though Take-Two shares wavered as investors eyed a PC version and online mode.

stories.title: Nasdaq erases 2026 gain as AI selloff deepens
stories.description: Anthropic gave back some of its debut gains as US indexes headed for their worst week since April 2025's Liberation Day tariffs.

stories.title: Trump floats Miller for 2028, upstaging Vance and Rubio
stories.description: At a White House briefing Friday, Trump said his new chief of staff outperformed Vance and Rubio, the leading 2028 Republican prospects.

stories.title: Estonia approves Russia border closure, Moscow vows reply
stories.description: All five road crossings will shut Dec. 1 for six months over alleged Russian sabotage; Moscow called it a new "Iron Curtain."

stories.title: Mamdani seeks to push Rikers closure deadline to 2032
stories.description: The plan would move detainees to four borough jails. The City Council must approve delaying the 2027 legal deadline.

stories.title: Trump seeks Ukraine deal before Democrats take Congress
stories.description: US officials told European and Ukrainian counterparts they want a deal by early January, the FT reports, stoking Kyiv's fears of concessions.

stories.title: Myanmar calls ICJ genocide ruling against it unfair
stories.description: A presidential spokeswoman said the 9-6 decision wasn't unanimous, a day after the court found Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.

stories.title: UK and EU agree Brexit reset deal, Downing Street says
stories.description: Burnham's office says the sides set timelines for a youth mobility scheme, a food safety pact and linked carbon markets.

stories.title: Trump signs Common Cents Act, ending penny production
stories.description: The law sets rules for rounding cash payments and lets the U.S. Mint make cheaper nickels. Existing pennies remain legal tender.

stories.title: Senate passes permitting overhaul 62-33, sends it to House
stories.description: The bill would speed approvals for power plants, transmission lines, mines and data centers, and President Trump says he will sign it.

stories.title: DOJ drops bid to block Alaska Senate certification
stories.description: DOJ told the 9th Circuit the case is moot after Mary Peltola beat Sen. Dan Sullivan, but wants the lower-court ruling vacated.

stories.title: Trump threatens 'tremendous tax' on data centers abroad
stories.description: Trump gave no details on how the tax would work, saying he hadn't yet told his own officials about the plan.

stories.title: Cincinnati Zoo's Fiona the hippo dies after swallowing hat
stories.description: The 9-year-old Nile hippo, famed since her premature 2017 birth, died 11 days after a visitor's hat fell into her habitat.

stories.title: Xi presses US on Taiwan as panel flags critical window
stories.description: A congressional advisory panel says China will use Taiwan's elections in 2026 and 2028 to test whether coercion can push unification.

stories.title: Second judge blocks Trump's arch, citing 'rushed job'
stories.description: Judge Leonie Brinkema will issue an indefinite injunction in Arlington County's suit, while the Justice Department vows an immediate appeal.

stories.title: Anthropic shares soar in record Nasdaq debut
stories.description: The Claude maker opened well above its $83 IPO price after raising $81.3 billion, the largest stock-market debut on record.

stories.title: Putin says Russia invited European envoys to Moscow
stories.description: Speaking in Shenzhen after meeting Trump and Xi, Putin said Russia will decide the format of Ukraine talks after hearing Europe's position.

stories.title: Trump hails Asia trip as success after Xi, Putin summit
stories.description: At his first news conference since the midterm losses, Trump claimed "unmatched" US strength. Critics said the three-way summit produced little.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO makes seven co-founders $20 billion each
stories.description: The $83-a-share pricing lifts the founders' combined fortune above $140 billion, per Bloomberg, ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut.

stories.title: Putin rules out truce after third Crimea bridge strike
stories.description: Putin vowed a "far more painful" response after Ukrainian missiles damaged the bridge's rail line, days after part of its road collapsed.

stories.title: Bessent says Trump, Xi agreed on human role in military AI
stories.description: The Treasury secretary called the agreement a key achievement of Trump's Asia trip and said U.S.-China AI competition will continue.

stories.title: UN court finds Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
stories.description: The International Court of Justice said Myanmar's 2017 military campaign killed about 10,000 Rohingya. It is the first of five pending genocide cases to reach a final ruling.

stories.title: Secretary of State Rubio weighs 2028 bid, allies say
stories.description: Rubio has declined to repeat his pledge to back Vice President JD Vance, sources say, as Trump sours on Vance's Iran critique.

stories.title: Zelensky calls Putin 'a killer' after Trump's friend remark
stories.description: Speaking after what he called Russia's biggest attack this year, Zelensky warned that treating Putin as a friend eases pressure on Moscow.

stories.title: Russia, China tout 'new level' of military cooperation
stories.description: Putin and Xi met in Shenzhen at APEC a day before a three-way summit with Trump, as Moscow floated jointly developing weapons.

stories.title: Gaza's $18bn rebuild stalls as Israel launches offensive
stories.description: Trump's Board of Peace warned the UN Security Council the truce could collapse, as stalled security and governance steps keep money frozen.

stories.title: Iran rejects Trump's chemical weapons claims, cites Iraq
stories.description: Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei pointed to Colin Powell's 2003 UN speech and accused Washington of recycling false pretexts to justify military action.

stories.title: Hegseth announces Venezuela deal to restore military ties
stories.description: The defense secretary's surprise Caracas visit, his first since Maduro's January capture, produced a pact covering training and intelligence sharing.

stories.title: Mullin tells Congress US tech outages not cyberattacks
stories.description: DNI Jay Clayton blamed maintenance and technical changes for failures that hit Microsoft, the FAA, banks and the NSA since Nov. 12.

stories.title: Thune expects debt limit fight to spill into 2027
stories.description: The Senate majority leader said Republicans lack the votes for a party-line increase, leaving Trump to negotiate with incoming Democratic majorities.

stories.title: UN nuclear chief backs US-Saudi deal inspection terms
stories.description: Rafael Grossi called the terms "very satisfactory" even though they skip the strictest inspection standard. The deal still needs approval from US lawmakers.

stories.title: US presses Kyiv, Moscow to weigh new NATO troop terms
stories.description: The push follows Russia's demand that NATO roll back deployments to 1997 lines, which leaders on the alliance's eastern flank quickly rejected.

stories.title: Trump warns Musk after he says he's 'not MAGA'
stories.description: Trump called Musk a friend but said those who veer from MAGA "don't do very well," following Republicans' midterm losses.

stories.title: UAE shipper ADNOC says sailor missing, 11 hurt in Hormuz attack
stories.description: The state oil company's shipping arm said the rest of the crew was evacuated but did not name the vessel or attacker.

stories.title: Israel's Knesset picks speaker backed by Netanyahu rivals
stories.description: Matan Kahana, an ally of opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, won 66 votes with Arab parties' support, giving Netanyahu's opponents control of parliament's agenda.

stories.title: Ueland vows GAO independence as GOP senators balk
stories.description: Trump's pick for top federal watchdog faced sharp Democratic criticism Thursday, days after the White House pulled its FDA nominee amid GOP defections.

stories.title: Jeffries wins Democrats' nod to be first Black speaker
stories.description: The New York Democrat won a secret-ballot caucus vote 251-11, according to the Washington Examiner, and faces a House vote in January.

stories.title: Russia rejects Ukraine NATO entry after US Donbas idea
stories.description: Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov called membership "categorically unacceptable" days after Zelensky said US negotiators floated a Donbas-for-NATO swap.

stories.title: Judge lets Trump's $15B defamation suit against NYT proceed
stories.description: U.S. District Judge Merryday rejected the Times' and Penguin Random House's dismissal bid, though he tossed two claims and narrowed four others.

stories.title: PAHO strips US of measles elimination status after 26 years
stories.description: PAHO found more than 12 months of continuous spread amid the worst U.S. outbreak since 1991; Mexico and Bolivia also lost status.

stories.title: Iran says US struck Qeshm Island, causing no damage
stories.description: The reported strikes came hours after the Revolutionary Guards said drones hit a US radar at Bahrain's Sheikh Isa Air Base.

stories.title: Trump departs China after first summit with Xi and Putin
stories.description: The roughly 90-minute three-way talks in Shenzhen produced no specific agreements, and a hinted Kim Jong Un meeting never materialized.

stories.title: Burnham says Brexit 'diminished' UK ahead of EU summit
stories.description: At the Lord Mayor's Banquet, Burnham said Brexit was what Britain's enemies wanted but ruled out rejoining the single market.

stories.title: Bahrain says it downed IRGC drones targeting US radar
stories.description: Blasts sounded over Manama in Iran's third attack on Bahrain in under a week, a day after Secretary of State Rubio condemned them.

stories.title: Trump, Xi, Putin issue four-point declaration in Shenzhen
stories.description: The first-ever three-way talks produced pledges on nuclear risk dialogue, UN reform and fuel supply, but omitted any mention of Ukraine.

stories.title: Deutsche Bank shares slide on $582M Epstein leak
stories.description: An FT-led review of 15 million leaked files also details a Trump tax data mix-up and Russia dealings that raise questions about CEO Christian Sewing.

stories.title: United Airlines resolves outage that delayed departures
stories.description: The pilots' union said the outage blocked final weight calculations, holding planes at gates days after an FAA router failure grounded flights.

stories.title: Memo shows IRS opened criminal probes of left-wing groups
stories.description: The investigations stem from Trump's crackdown after Charlie Kirk's killing, according to an internal memo viewed by The New York Times.

stories.title: Commerce issues rule curbing remote AI chip access loophole
stories.description: The interim rule targets a loophole that let Chinese firms rent Nvidia's advanced processors through data centers in third countries.

stories.title: Zelensky urges Musk, US to lift Starshield speed caps
stories.description: Zelensky says the caps let Russia's jet-powered Shahed drones evade interceptors and hit energy substations as winter approaches.

stories.title: Trump nominates LaNeve as permanent Army chief of staff
stories.description: LaNeve, Hegseth's former aide and acting chief since April, faces bipartisan Senate doubts before a Democratic majority takes over Jan. 3.

stories.title: NTSB recovers tanker data recorder in New Orleans crash
stories.description: The device logs speed, course and bridge audio from the Atlantic Asphalt, which struck and sank a docked paddle-wheeler Friday.

stories.title: FAA traces ground stop to Arkansas, Texas network gear
stories.description: A new router in El Dorado and equipment in Amarillo flooded FAA networks, forcing Friday's halt that canceled more than 14,000 flights.

stories.title: Fed's Cook won't join White House hearing without changes
stories.description: Lawyer Abbe Lowell called the Dec. 14 mortgage fraud inquiry a "façade" meant to justify a predetermined decision to fire her.

stories.title: NYT: Lutnick sought softer chip rules tied to family firm
stories.description: The Times says a Malaysian data center serving a Chinese tech giant is a Cantor Fitzgerald client, two days after Bessent's rebuke.

stories.title: Kushner says US now aims to broker Europe-Russia talks
stories.description: The envoy's shift came as Zelenskyy said U.S. negotiators floated Ukraine leaving Donbas in exchange for NATO membership, a trade Kyiv rejects.

stories.title: Trump warns Iran over reported dirty bomb plot on DC
stories.description: Speaking in Manila, Trump said Iran would pay an unprecedented price, after CNN reported intelligence on Iranian plans targeting senior officials.

stories.title: Boebert concedes after losing Colorado seat to Laubacher
stories.description: Democrat Eileen Laubacher, a retired Navy rear admiral, won the 4th District, which Trump carried by more than 18 points in 2024.

stories.title: Russia revives demand that NATO pull back to 1997 lines
stories.description: A position paper shared with Trump's envoys in Abu Dhabi repeats Moscow's pre-invasion terms, signaling Putin hasn't budged, the New York Times reports.

stories.title: Judge strikes down Trump four-year cap on student visas
stories.description: Judge F. Dennis Saylor IV called DHS's rule arbitrary and capricious, preserving open-ended stays for F-1 and J-1 visa holders.

stories.title: Democratic senators order Musk to preserve Starlink records
stories.description: The demand comes as Zelensky says Starshield speed caps have returned over occupied territory, a claim SpaceX denies.

stories.title: Trump administration delays Medicaid work rule penalties
stories.description: New CMS guidance lets states hold off on coverage cuts through June 2027, though the requirement still formally starts Jan. 1.

stories.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump bid to cut UC research grants
stories.description: The justices left in place a ruling blocking about $59 million in diversity-related grant cuts that lower courts called likely viewpoint discrimination.

stories.title: Tanker hits docked New Orleans riverboat, 32 hospitalized
stories.description: The American Heritage capsized after the Atlantic Asphalt struck it Friday. Mayor Helena Moreno said everyone aboard was accounted for.

stories.title: EU leaders reject Putin's demand for NATO rollback
stories.description: At a Dublin summit, Merz and Kallas dismissed Moscow's bid to reopen Europe's security order after Putin revived 2021 NATO demands.

stories.title: Miller and Rubio, once immigration foes, now close allies
stories.description: The Wall Street Journal reports Trump's new chief of staff and secretary of state now form a quietly consequential partnership.

stories.title: Taiwan says unannounced Chinese drills simulated attacks
stories.description: A Taiwan official called the drills "silent intimidation." The drills involved more than 100 vessels and came ahead of next week's APEC summit in Shenzhen.

stories.title: Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate majority leader
stories.description: Schumer says he has the votes to keep his post before a Dec. 1 secret-ballot vote, after Democrats won Senate control.

top.title: Russian envoy says nuclear war with NATO inching closer
top.description: Russia's OSCE envoy Dmitry Polyansky accused NATO members of joining drone attacks on Russian ships in the Baltic Sea.

top.title: Trump says Nvidia's Huang is not a security threat
top.description: Trump cited "a lot of information" even though the Justice Department never opened a formal probe, and called Huang's reinstatement "a great thing."

top.title: Thanksgiving storms knock out power to over 700,000
top.description: A strengthening nor'easter and Midwest snow hit Virginia, Maryland and Missouri hardest, canceling flights and forcing postponement of Macy's 100th parade.

top.title: IISS warns Russian sabotage in Europe risks mass casualties
top.description: A London think tank says incidents involving explosives and arson roughly doubled over the past year, with Germany and Poland hit hardest.

top.title: Iran denies Kuwait drone strike that killed two Italians
top.description: Military spokesperson Abolfazl Shekarchi called the accusations a false-flag pretext, after Kuwait and Italy said Iranian drones targeted an air-defense site.

top.title: Trump calls pre-election GDP data fake, demands investigation
top.description: Trump alleged without evidence that a routine revision lifting third-quarter growth to 4.3% from 3.4% exposed a deliberate pre-election undercount.

top.title: Iran rations power, cuts bread subsidies under US blockade
top.description: President Masoud Pezeshkian told state television "we have no money" as a U.S. naval blockade and months of war drain Iran's finances.

top.title: UK net migration falls to 77,000, lowest since 1997
top.description: ONS provisional figures show net migration more than halved in a year, driven by fewer non-EU arrivals for work and study.

top.title: France defends Ukraine's Libya strikes as Italy objects
top.description: Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot cited Kyiv's right to self-defense, while Italy's Antonio Tajani said the strikes near Benghazi violated Libya's sovereignty.

top.title: NATO allies expect US to delay Europe troop cut decision
top.description: Allies now expect cuts of about 5,000 troops, mostly in Germany, as the Trump administration focuses on Ukraine peace talks, Bloomberg reports.

top.title: Kim urges wider tactical nuclear deployment on site tour
top.description: Touring nuclear material factories and a weapons institute, Kim called North Korea's nuclear status "absolutely inviolable," according to state media KCNA.

top.title: Kushner says Putin showed restraint, vowed not to use nuclear weapons
top.description: In a podcast interview, the White House envoy called Putin a "grandmaster of politics" and said territorial talks on Ukraine are deadlocked.

top.title: Storm pushes 100th Macy's parade to Saturday, a first
top.description: Forecast gusts near 60 mph on Thanksgiving Day exceed balloon safety limits. NBC will air the 2025 parade Thursday instead.

top.title: Judge upholds Mamdani's rent freeze, tosses landlord suit
top.description: Justice Brendan Lantry found the Rent Guidelines Board acted rationally, though he called Mamdani's campaign freeze pledge "reckless and irresponsible."

top.title: Democrats demand AI curbs over unreleased model fears
top.description: Sens. Kelly, Schatz and Van Hollen, joined by Sanders, urged swift guardrails after insiders doubted labs can safely control unreleased systems.

top.title: Finland, Norway used oligarch to reach Putin, WSJ says
top.description: Stubb and Støre sought to ease Kremlin fears of a NATO blockade in the Baltic Sea before their Oct. 27 call with Putin.

top.title: EU, China reject US overcapacity claims behind new tariffs
top.description: Trade Representative Greer proposed Section 301 duties on 14 economies, including 15% on EU goods and up to 20% on Chinese imports.

top.title: FCC clears SpaceX for 1 million orbital data centers
top.description: The FCC approved SpaceX's Starmind constellation, which the agency says will help meet fast-growing demand for AI computing power.

top.title: Poland to create no-fly zone along Ukraine border
top.description: Deputy Defense Minister Cezary Tomczyk said the ordinance should take effect around year's end, after Russian missile and drone incursions.

top.title: Army detonates lead azide stockpile in Iowa despite outcry
top.description: The controlled blast near Middletown destroyed the nation's entire stock of the degraded explosive after a court cleared the EPA's emergency permit.

top.title: Macron vows to halt EU budget talks without December deal
top.description: The warning came a day before a Brussels summit, as France rejects proposed cuts to farm aid in the EU's 2028–2034 budget.

top.title: Alice Huang-linked firms used $270M AI servers for loans
top.description: Chinese central-bank filings reviewed by Reuters show firms tied to her family leased or pledged the hardware, days after Washington blacklisted Megaspeed.

top.title: Fed's preferred inflation gauge climbs to 3.8% in October
top.description: Core PCE rose to 3.3%, above forecasts, strengthening expectations of a rate hike at the Federal Reserve's Dec. 8–9 meeting.

top.title: US shelves Russia business lure in Ukraine talks, FT says
top.description: Envoys Kushner and Witkoff told Europeans corporate partnerships are no longer central after Moscow showed little interest; a US official disputed it.

top.title: Trump approves disaster declaration for Florida flooding
top.description: Federal aid will help residents in six counties as National Guard troops clear flooded Hollywood homes and Lake Monroe nears its crest.

top.title: US proposes tariffs up to 20% on China, EU, 12 others
top.description: The USTR wrapped up its excess-capacity probe for 14 economies. The duties could take effect as early as January, after public hearings.

top.title: US jury convicts Huawei of bank fraud, trade secret theft
top.description: A Brooklyn federal jury found the Chinese tech giant guilty on 10 of 12 counts but acquitted it of racketeering conspiracy.

top.title: CIA, ODNI hit by breach of open-source intel network
top.description: The intrusion exposed some unclassified information on an open-source analysis platform. Officials say classified systems were not affected, and the attacker remains unknown.

top.title: Trump aides debate targeting Iran's leaders, NBC reports
top.description: Supporters say striking Iran's leadership could end the nearly nine-month war. Critics warn it could embolden remaining hardliners and endanger U.S. officials.

top.title: DOJ targets 800-plus defendants in largest scam crackdown
top.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche says prosecutors recovered over $8 billion in intended victim losses, with the FBI citing nearly $17 billion restrained.

top.title: US consumer confidence jumps to 103.3 after midterms
top.description: The Conference Board's index beat forecasts and returned to levels last seen in January 2025 as job optimism grew and gas prices fell.

top.title: Zelenskyy confirms drone strike on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland
top.description: He called cargo vessel Sparta II a legitimate target, claiming it carried weapons, ending Kyiv's silence on the Gulf of Finland attack.

top.title: Riyadh's tallest tower struck again in less than a week
top.description: The Saudi-led coalition called Tuesday's strike on the Public Investment Fund tower a "cowardly terrorist attack." No group has claimed responsibility.

top.title: Pentagon in talks with GM, Ford on drones, report says
top.description: Automakers would supply motors, sensors and parts as the military plans to buy millions of drones, according to The Wall Street Journal.

top.title: Pentagon chief stalls Patriot missiles for Ukraine, FT says
top.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth hasn't approved about 60 allied-funded interceptors as Russia intensifies strikes on Ukrainian cities and energy infrastructure before winter.

top.title: Russian warplanes in South Korean airspace spark shelter alert
top.description: South Korea's military says the planes entered KADIZ but never violated its airspace, correcting earlier alerts, one wrongly citing North Korean aircraft.

top.title: US probes Iran over cyberattacks on up to 50 ships
top.description: Some crews received bomb threats, The Wall Street Journal reports, and investigators also see Russia as a possible culprit.

top.title: Senate Democrat probes Vance over Vitol Venezuela oil deal
top.description: Sen. Maggie Hassan cites flight records placing Vance and a Vitol donor in Montana before Maduro's capture. Vance's office denies the meeting.

top.title: US weighs demining training mission for Syrian army
top.description: It would be the first US training mission with Syria's military since former rebels took power in 2024, sources told Reuters.

top.title: Meduza, Mediazona estimate 700,000 Russian war dead
top.description: The exiled outlets based the figure on hacked Rosstat mortality records showing at least 490,000 registered military deaths through late September.

top.title: Trump slams Newsom's death row commutations at DOJ
top.description: Trump said he will sign a directive ordering the Justice Department to seek death sentences for child murderers and to speed up federal executions.

top.title: Iran says four tankers hit mines in Strait of Hormuz
top.description: Tehran says two of the vessels sailed with US Central Command support. No ships were named, and no one has independently confirmed the claims.

top.title: Backlash grows after COP31 collapses over fossil fuels
top.description: The EU and Pacific nations rejected a final draft omitting fossil fuels, ending the record-long Antalya summit Sunday without an overarching agreement.

top.title: 2nd Circuit revives Trump bid to move hush money case
top.description: A three-judge panel said a lower-court judge erred in blocking removal and sent the case back to district court for a prompt ruling.

top.title: Rep. Jimmy Gomez to resign after House Ethics findings
top.description: The committee found "substantial evidence" the Los Angeles Democrat made unwelcome sexual advances toward a House staffer; he disputes the report's conclusions.

top.title: NATO intelligence warns Russia readying nuclear satellite
top.description: A German media investigation says the Sputnik-S satellite, stored near Moscow, could launch by December. Russia's embassy calls the claims propaganda.

top.title: OpenAI chief scientist urges perplexity-based AI limits
top.description: Jakub Pachocki's essay seeks industry-wide development caps and discloses OpenAI's internal pretraining data for the first time; no other lab has joined.

top.title: DNI Clayton says Putin 'not America's friend in Ukraine'
top.description: Clayton also defended Trump calling Putin his "friend" at last week's Shenzhen summit with Xi, saying he trusts the president "completely."

top.title: Gov. Ferguson says ICE 'beyond reform' after Sea-Tac arrests
top.description: Masked agents detained two people on a jet bridge as passengers boarded an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles on Saturday.

top.title: Iran calls US blockade act of war, vows to break it
top.description: Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi also said Qatari mediators visited Tehran for talks, as Revolutionary Guards claimed strikes on US sites in Bahrain.

top.title: Trump says US working on broader Russia-Ukraine truce
top.description: Trump called the truce that Melania Trump brokered to evacuate civilians from Russian-occupied Oleshky a pilot project. He gave no timeline for a wider deal.

top.title: Crimean Bridge cleanup to take months, Khmara says
top.description: Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara said Russian divers are still assessing the collapsed span, which now blocks ships passing through the Kerch Strait.

top.title: Turnout falls at France's sixth weekend of protests
top.description: The Interior Ministry counted 82,500 marchers nationwide, down from a week earlier, as clashes broke out in Marseille, Lyon and Lille.

top.title: WSJ: Kim snubbed Trump outreach as summit bid collapsed
top.description: Kim ignored contact attempts, including an unopened letter, and Pyongyang's conditions sank a planned meeting during Trump's Asia trip, the Journal reported.

top.title: Bolsonaro in ICU with bowel obstruction, surgery weighed
top.description: DF Star hospital says the former president, serving a 27-year coup sentence, is stable and conscious, with no discharge date set.

top.title: White House to scale back special employee status
top.description: Chief of staff Stephen Miller wants to wind down the designation letting staffers keep outside salaries, The Wall Street Journal reported.

top.title: Vance won't say he would have ordered Iran strikes
top.description: Standing beside Trump on Friday, Vance said the decision belonged to the president, sidestepping Trump's push to call the attacks necessary.

top.title: Israeli strikes across southern Lebanon strain US-brokered deal
top.description: Israeli drones, jets and artillery hit towns in southern Lebanon on Friday and Saturday, following a Thursday strike deep in the Bekaa Valley.

top.title: Jeffries vows first-week House push to end Iran war
top.description: The speaker nominee also called Gaza's devastation "unacceptable" and urged a surge in humanitarian aid and a two-state solution.

top.title: FBI questions ex-Fulton elections chief in 2020 probe
top.description: Richard Barron, who oversaw Fulton County's 2020 count, said prosecutors including Dan Bishop focused on debunked claims and "trivial topics."

top.title: Denmark urges EU to halt tourist visas for Russians
top.description: Copenhagen will present its proposals to EU ambassadors Monday after Danish intelligence blamed Russia for a foiled plot to kill rapper Kyivstoner.

top.title: Trump says any deal to end Iran war must be 'permanent'
top.description: Trump said he wants an agreement binding future presidents. He cited Iran's record of broken deals as the war nears nine months.

top.title: Young Europeans strike over living costs, rearmament
top.description: Students in at least 25 countries walked out Friday, saying money spent on military buildups should go to schools and housing instead.

top.title: Iran's Araghchi says China, Russia oppose doctrine shift
top.description: Araghchi said Tehran's rejection of nuclear weapons remains unchanged, as hardliners push for a deterrent after wars with Israel and the US.

top.title: Iran unveils launcher that fires two missiles at once
top.description: State TV aired footage from an underground "missile city" to counter U.S. claims it destroyed Iran's missile program, amid new tanker attacks.

top.title: Trump says FBI crime database hack could reveal 'hoaxes'
top.description: The president told Fox News the National Crime Information Center breach might expose details on the Russia probe and voter fraud.

top.title: Canada says no shift after Hegseth memo restricts ties
top.description: Defense Minister David McGuinty said he hadn't seen the classified Pentagon memo, which reportedly limits U.S.-Canada military engagement outside NORAD and NATO.

top.title: US military denies Iran claim it damaged F-16 over Gulf
top.description: Central Command called Iran's account false and said all US fighter jets in the Middle East are safe and accounted for.

top.title: Iran's president says economic war harder than missiles
top.description: Masoud Pezeshkian warned damaged gas infrastructure will make winter hard, saying government offices, not factories, would lose power first during shortages.

top.title: Trump says he'd work with Democrats on credit card cap
top.description: Trump told Fox News card companies "are getting too much," after Sen. Elizabeth Warren offered to help pass a 10% cap.

top.title: Zelensky rejects Musk claim he lied about Starshield
top.description: Ukraine's president told CNN his reports of military satellite disruptions were "100% truth," days after Musk accused him of lying.

top.title: Israeli strikes kill four in Gaza as floods swamp camps
top.description: Aid agencies say over 100,000 tents remain stuck outside Gaza, while COGAT says more than 93,000 have entered.

top.title: Trump orders contractors to flag congressional info requests
top.description: Signed Friday, the order threatens noncompliant companies with lost contracts as Democrats prepare to take over Congress and launch investigations.

top.title: DHS urges staff to keep holiday talk about jobs vague
top.description: An email from the department's counterintelligence division gave employees scripted answers, like saying they work for the federal government near Washington.

top.title: Mexico captures FBI most-wanted fugitive 'El Chapo Isidro'
top.description: Special forces seized Fausto Isidro Meza Flores in Guasave, Sinaloa, on Friday, setting off gunfire, arson and road blockades across northern Sinaloa.

top.title: Speaker Johnson tells absent Republicans to show up
top.description: Absences by defeated GOP members forced leaders to scrap a vote this week, with Republicans' House majority ending Jan. 3.

top.title: Iraqi troops enter Iran-backed militia's main stronghold
top.description: A brokered deal gives Kataib Hezbollah a month to leave Jurf al-Sakhar, which government forces had not entered in over a decade.

top.title: Iran claims it shot down 58th US Reaper drone over Hormuz
top.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards credited a newly deployed air defense system. The claim couldn't be independently verified, and no US response was reported.

top.title: Houthi attacks fuel doubts on Trump's Saudi nuclear deal
top.description: Senate aides say a disapproval vote could come as early as the week of Nov. 30, amid new security fears.

top.title: UN talks on killer robots end without binding commitment
top.description: Countries agreed to "elaborate" rules on autonomous weapons by 2028 after the U.S., Russia and Israel resisted a push for binding limits.

top.title: Jury convicts Rinderknecht in Palisades Fire retrial
top.description: The verdict came almost five months after his first trial ended in a mistrial, with jurors deadlocked 10-2 toward acquittal.

top.title: Tusk rejects Trump's 'mistake' claim after missile crash
top.description: Russian missiles and a drone fell in southeastern Poland during a large attack on Ukraine, hours after Trump's comments.

top.title: Rockstar says GTA VI hit record $3.79B in day-one sales
top.description: The launch-day haul tops Avengers: Endgame's lifetime box office, though Take-Two shares wavered as investors eyed a PC version and online mode.

top.title: Nasdaq erases 2026 gain as AI selloff deepens
top.description: Anthropic gave back some of its debut gains as US indexes headed for their worst week since April 2025's Liberation Day tariffs.

top.title: Trump floats Miller for 2028, upstaging Vance and Rubio
top.description: At a White House briefing Friday, Trump said his new chief of staff outperformed Vance and Rubio, the leading 2028 Republican prospects.

top.title: Estonia approves Russia border closure, Moscow vows reply
top.description: All five road crossings will shut Dec. 1 for six months over alleged Russian sabotage; Moscow called it a new "Iron Curtain."

top.title: Mamdani seeks to push Rikers closure deadline to 2032
top.description: The plan would move detainees to four borough jails. The City Council must approve delaying the 2027 legal deadline.

top.title: Trump seeks Ukraine deal before Democrats take Congress
top.description: US officials told European and Ukrainian counterparts they want a deal by early January, the FT reports, stoking Kyiv's fears of concessions.

top.title: Myanmar calls ICJ genocide ruling against it unfair
top.description: A presidential spokeswoman said the 9-6 decision wasn't unanimous, a day after the court found Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.

top.title: UK and EU agree Brexit reset deal, Downing Street says
top.description: Burnham's office says the sides set timelines for a youth mobility scheme, a food safety pact and linked carbon markets.

top.title: Trump signs Common Cents Act, ending penny production
top.description: The law sets rules for rounding cash payments and lets the U.S. Mint make cheaper nickels. Existing pennies remain legal tender.

top.title: Senate passes permitting overhaul 62-33, sends it to House
top.description: The bill would speed approvals for power plants, transmission lines, mines and data centers, and President Trump says he will sign it.

top.title: DOJ drops bid to block Alaska Senate certification
top.description: DOJ told the 9th Circuit the case is moot after Mary Peltola beat Sen. Dan Sullivan, but wants the lower-court ruling vacated.

top.title: Trump threatens 'tremendous tax' on data centers abroad
top.description: Trump gave no details on how the tax would work, saying he hadn't yet told his own officials about the plan.

top.title: Cincinnati Zoo's Fiona the hippo dies after swallowing hat
top.description: The 9-year-old Nile hippo, famed since her premature 2017 birth, died 11 days after a visitor's hat fell into her habitat.

top.title: Xi presses US on Taiwan as panel flags critical window
top.description: A congressional advisory panel says China will use Taiwan's elections in 2026 and 2028 to test whether coercion can push unification.

top.title: Second judge blocks Trump's arch, citing 'rushed job'
top.description: Judge Leonie Brinkema will issue an indefinite injunction in Arlington County's suit, while the Justice Department vows an immediate appeal.

top.title: Anthropic shares soar in record Nasdaq debut
top.description: The Claude maker opened well above its $83 IPO price after raising $81.3 billion, the largest stock-market debut on record.

top.title: Putin says Russia invited European envoys to Moscow
top.description: Speaking in Shenzhen after meeting Trump and Xi, Putin said Russia will decide the format of Ukraine talks after hearing Europe's position.

top.title: Trump hails Asia trip as success after Xi, Putin summit
top.description: At his first news conference since the midterm losses, Trump claimed "unmatched" US strength. Critics said the three-way summit produced little.

top.title: Anthropic IPO makes seven co-founders $20 billion each
top.description: The $83-a-share pricing lifts the founders' combined fortune above $140 billion, per Bloomberg, ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut.

top.title: Putin rules out truce after third Crimea bridge strike
top.description: Putin vowed a "far more painful" response after Ukrainian missiles damaged the bridge's rail line, days after part of its road collapsed.

top.title: Bessent says Trump, Xi agreed on human role in military AI
top.description: The Treasury secretary called the agreement a key achievement of Trump's Asia trip and said U.S.-China AI competition will continue.

top.title: UN court finds Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
top.description: The International Court of Justice said Myanmar's 2017 military campaign killed about 10,000 Rohingya. It is the first of five pending genocide cases to reach a final ruling.

top.title: Secretary of State Rubio weighs 2028 bid, allies say
top.description: Rubio has declined to repeat his pledge to back Vice President JD Vance, sources say, as Trump sours on Vance's Iran critique.

top.title: Zelensky calls Putin 'a killer' after Trump's friend remark
top.description: Speaking after what he called Russia's biggest attack this year, Zelensky warned that treating Putin as a friend eases pressure on Moscow.

top.title: Russia, China tout 'new level' of military cooperation
top.description: Putin and Xi met in Shenzhen at APEC a day before a three-way summit with Trump, as Moscow floated jointly developing weapons.

top.title: Gaza's $18bn rebuild stalls as Israel launches offensive
top.description: Trump's Board of Peace warned the UN Security Council the truce could collapse, as stalled security and governance steps keep money frozen.

top.title: Iran rejects Trump's chemical weapons claims, cites Iraq
top.description: Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei pointed to Colin Powell's 2003 UN speech and accused Washington of recycling false pretexts to justify military action.

top.title: Hegseth announces Venezuela deal to restore military ties
top.description: The defense secretary's surprise Caracas visit, his first since Maduro's January capture, produced a pact covering training and intelligence sharing.

top.title: Mullin tells Congress US tech outages not cyberattacks
top.description: DNI Jay Clayton blamed maintenance and technical changes for failures that hit Microsoft, the FAA, banks and the NSA since Nov. 12.

top.title: Thune expects debt limit fight to spill into 2027
top.description: The Senate majority leader said Republicans lack the votes for a party-line increase, leaving Trump to negotiate with incoming Democratic majorities.

top.title: UN nuclear chief backs US-Saudi deal inspection terms
top.description: Rafael Grossi called the terms "very satisfactory" even though they skip the strictest inspection standard. The deal still needs approval from US lawmakers.

top.title: US presses Kyiv, Moscow to weigh new NATO troop terms
top.description: The push follows Russia's demand that NATO roll back deployments to 1997 lines, which leaders on the alliance's eastern flank quickly rejected.

top.title: Trump warns Musk after he says he's 'not MAGA'
top.description: Trump called Musk a friend but said those who veer from MAGA "don't do very well," following Republicans' midterm losses.

top.title: UAE shipper ADNOC says sailor missing, 11 hurt in Hormuz attack
top.description: The state oil company's shipping arm said the rest of the crew was evacuated but did not name the vessel or attacker.

top.title: Israel's Knesset picks speaker backed by Netanyahu rivals
top.description: Matan Kahana, an ally of opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, won 66 votes with Arab parties' support, giving Netanyahu's opponents control of parliament's agenda.

top.title: Ueland vows GAO independence as GOP senators balk
top.description: Trump's pick for top federal watchdog faced sharp Democratic criticism Thursday, days after the White House pulled its FDA nominee amid GOP defections.

top.title: Jeffries wins Democrats' nod to be first Black speaker
top.description: The New York Democrat won a secret-ballot caucus vote 251-11, according to the Washington Examiner, and faces a House vote in January.

top.title: Russia rejects Ukraine NATO entry after US Donbas idea
top.description: Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov called membership "categorically unacceptable" days after Zelensky said US negotiators floated a Donbas-for-NATO swap.

top.title: Judge lets Trump's $15B defamation suit against NYT proceed
top.description: U.S. District Judge Merryday rejected the Times' and Penguin Random House's dismissal bid, though he tossed two claims and narrowed four others.

top.title: PAHO strips US of measles elimination status after 26 years
top.description: PAHO found more than 12 months of continuous spread amid the worst U.S. outbreak since 1991; Mexico and Bolivia also lost status.

top.title: Iran says US struck Qeshm Island, causing no damage
top.description: The reported strikes came hours after the Revolutionary Guards said drones hit a US radar at Bahrain's Sheikh Isa Air Base.

top.title: Trump departs China after first summit with Xi and Putin
top.description: The roughly 90-minute three-way talks in Shenzhen produced no specific agreements, and a hinted Kim Jong Un meeting never materialized.

top.title: Burnham says Brexit 'diminished' UK ahead of EU summit
top.description: At the Lord Mayor's Banquet, Burnham said Brexit was what Britain's enemies wanted but ruled out rejoining the single market.

top.title: Bahrain says it downed IRGC drones targeting US radar
top.description: Blasts sounded over Manama in Iran's third attack on Bahrain in under a week, a day after Secretary of State Rubio condemned them.

top.title: Trump, Xi, Putin issue four-point declaration in Shenzhen
top.description: The first-ever three-way talks produced pledges on nuclear risk dialogue, UN reform and fuel supply, but omitted any mention of Ukraine.

top.title: Deutsche Bank shares slide on $582M Epstein leak
top.description: An FT-led review of 15 million leaked files also details a Trump tax data mix-up and Russia dealings that raise questions about CEO Christian Sewing.

top.title: United Airlines resolves outage that delayed departures
top.description: The pilots' union said the outage blocked final weight calculations, holding planes at gates days after an FAA router failure grounded flights.

top.title: Memo shows IRS opened criminal probes of left-wing groups
top.description: The investigations stem from Trump's crackdown after Charlie Kirk's killing, according to an internal memo viewed by The New York Times.

top.title: Commerce issues rule curbing remote AI chip access loophole
top.description: The interim rule targets a loophole that let Chinese firms rent Nvidia's advanced processors through data centers in third countries.

top.title: Zelensky urges Musk, US to lift Starshield speed caps
top.description: Zelensky says the caps let Russia's jet-powered Shahed drones evade interceptors and hit energy substations as winter approaches.

top.title: Trump nominates LaNeve as permanent Army chief of staff
top.description: LaNeve, Hegseth's former aide and acting chief since April, faces bipartisan Senate doubts before a Democratic majority takes over Jan. 3.

top.title: NTSB recovers tanker data recorder in New Orleans crash
top.description: The device logs speed, course and bridge audio from the Atlantic Asphalt, which struck and sank a docked paddle-wheeler Friday.

top.title: FAA traces ground stop to Arkansas, Texas network gear
top.description: A new router in El Dorado and equipment in Amarillo flooded FAA networks, forcing Friday's halt that canceled more than 14,000 flights.

top.title: Fed's Cook won't join White House hearing without changes
top.description: Lawyer Abbe Lowell called the Dec. 14 mortgage fraud inquiry a "façade" meant to justify a predetermined decision to fire her.

top.title: NYT: Lutnick sought softer chip rules tied to family firm
top.description: The Times says a Malaysian data center serving a Chinese tech giant is a Cantor Fitzgerald client, two days after Bessent's rebuke.

top.title: Kushner says US now aims to broker Europe-Russia talks
top.description: The envoy's shift came as Zelenskyy said U.S. negotiators floated Ukraine leaving Donbas in exchange for NATO membership, a trade Kyiv rejects.

top.title: Trump warns Iran over reported dirty bomb plot on DC
top.description: Speaking in Manila, Trump said Iran would pay an unprecedented price, after CNN reported intelligence on Iranian plans targeting senior officials.

top.title: Boebert concedes after losing Colorado seat to Laubacher
top.description: Democrat Eileen Laubacher, a retired Navy rear admiral, won the 4th District, which Trump carried by more than 18 points in 2024.

top.title: Russia revives demand that NATO pull back to 1997 lines
top.description: A position paper shared with Trump's envoys in Abu Dhabi repeats Moscow's pre-invasion terms, signaling Putin hasn't budged, the New York Times reports.

top.title: Judge strikes down Trump four-year cap on student visas
top.description: Judge F. Dennis Saylor IV called DHS's rule arbitrary and capricious, preserving open-ended stays for F-1 and J-1 visa holders.

top.title: Democratic senators order Musk to preserve Starlink records
top.description: The demand comes as Zelensky says Starshield speed caps have returned over occupied territory, a claim SpaceX denies.

top.title: Trump administration delays Medicaid work rule penalties
top.description: New CMS guidance lets states hold off on coverage cuts through June 2027, though the requirement still formally starts Jan. 1.

top.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump bid to cut UC research grants
top.description: The justices left in place a ruling blocking about $59 million in diversity-related grant cuts that lower courts called likely viewpoint discrimination.

top.title: Tanker hits docked New Orleans riverboat, 32 hospitalized
top.description: The American Heritage capsized after the Atlantic Asphalt struck it Friday. Mayor Helena Moreno said everyone aboard was accounted for.

top.title: EU leaders reject Putin's demand for NATO rollback
top.description: At a Dublin summit, Merz and Kallas dismissed Moscow's bid to reopen Europe's security order after Putin revived 2021 NATO demands.

top.title: Miller and Rubio, once immigration foes, now close allies
top.description: The Wall Street Journal reports Trump's new chief of staff and secretary of state now form a quietly consequential partnership.

top.title: Taiwan says unannounced Chinese drills simulated attacks
top.description: A Taiwan official called the drills "silent intimidation." The drills involved more than 100 vessels and came ahead of next week's APEC summit in Shenzhen.

top.title: Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate majority leader
top.description: Schumer says he has the votes to keep his post before a Dec. 1 secret-ballot vote, after Democrats won Senate control.
